step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture diagram illustrates HealthFirst's serverless data platform on AWS.
1. Operational Data Flow: External operational data sources send real-time transactions into an operational Database, which syncs updates back to operational sources.
2. CloudFormation Orchestration: CloudFormation acts as the deployment and orchestration trigger for three processing tiers: Redshift (Ingestion), Step Functions, and Lambda functions.
3. Analysis Pipeline (Top): Redshift processes data into the ANALYSIS S3 bucket while SQS handles exception handling, logging, and messaging. Data from the ANALYSIS S3 bucket feeds into a serving Redshift instance consumed by business analysts.
4. Core Pipeline (Middle): Step Functions orchestrate data transformations into the CORE S3 bucket, which interacts bidirectionally with AWS Glue for ETL and cataloging.
5. Insights Pipeline (Bottom): Lambda functions output transformed data into the INSIGHTS S3 bucket, which feeds into AWS SageMaker for machine learning model training and scoring.

graph.name: HealthFirst Serverless Data and Analytics Architecture
graph.notes: Data platform processing 20+ data sources and ~40TB daily using serverless abstraction layers (Analysis, Core, Insights).

nodes.name: DATA SOURCE
nodes.notes: 20+ real-time external and operational data sources producing ~40TB daily.

nodes.name: CLOUDFORMATION
nodes.notes: Triggers and deploys acquisition and ingestion pipelines based on triggers, events, or time.

nodes.name: SQS
nodes.notes: Used for messaging, exception handling, and logging during pipeline execution.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT (Ingestion)
nodes.notes: Ingestion warehouse instance kicked off by CloudFormation.

nodes.name: ANALYSIS
nodes.notes: S3 abstraction layer for R&D and preliminary analysis.

nodes.name: REDSHIFT (Serving)
nodes.notes: Serving data warehouse layer for downstream consumers.

nodes.name: STEP FUNCTION
nodes.notes: Orchestrates complex business logic, rules, and branching workflows.

nodes.name: CORE
nodes.notes: S3 abstraction layer for core strategic enterprise data.

nodes.name: GLUE
nodes.notes: Used for data ingestion, transformation, loading, and Glue Data Catalog.

nodes.name: LAMBDA
nodes.notes: Serverless execution for lightweight real-time event processing.

nodes.name: INSIGHTS
nodes.notes: S3 abstraction layer for data science and advanced analytics.

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: SageMaker and SageMaker Notebooks used for scoring data and machine learning.

nodes.name: User
nodes.notes: Business analysts and end consumers consuming operational insights.

edges.notes: Operational data feeds into operational database.
Database syncs updates back to operational systems.
CloudFormation triggers/deploys the Redshift ingestion pipeline.
Ingestion Redshift outputs data to the ANALYSIS S3 bucket.
SQS logs exception messages and manages pipeline execution states.
Data from ANALYSIS S3 is loaded into serving Redshift.
Serving Redshift delivers queries and reports to analyst users.
Step Functions orchestrate transformations into CORE S3.
AWS Glue catalogs and processes data from CORE S3.
Glue writes transformed data back to CORE S3 bucket.
Lambda processes events into INSIGHTS S3 bucket.
INSIGHTS S3 feeds data into SageMaker for model scoring.
